title: Integrated Macintosh Flexible Tip Fiber Optic Laryngoscope Blade
short_description: Flexible tip levering laryngoscope blade engineered for difficult airway intubation with integrated fiber-optic bundle.
full_description: Manufactured from German surgical stainless steel AISI 303/304, featuring an adjustable distal tip controlled by a rear lever for elevation of the epiglottis during difficult laryngoscopy.
specifications_markdown:
• Integrated fiber-optic light bundle
• Flexible articulating tip with thumb control lever
• Autoclavable up to 134°C
• Complies with ISO 7376 standards
